p: Every man of the children of: In the twelve tribes were four principle standards, so that every three tribes had their standard.
of Issachar: Judah, Issachar and Zebulun the sons of Leah were of the first standard.
camp of Judah were an hundred: Of those who were contained under that name.
of Reuben according to their armies: Reuben and Simeon, the sons of Leah, and Gad, the son of Zilpah her maid, were of the second standard.
midst of the camp: Because it might be an equal distance from each one, and all indifferently have recourse to it.
On the west side shall be: Because Ephraim and Manasseh took the place of Joseph their father, they are taken as Rachel's children, so they and Benjamin make the third standard.
Dan shall be on the north: Dan and Naphtali the sons of Bilhah Rachel's maid with Asher the son of Zilpah make the fourth standard.
those which were numbered of the: Which were of twenty years and above.
standards: For under every one of the four principal standards, were various signs to keep every band.
